objective: Map edge boundaries and distinguish broad plateaus from isolated or boundary optima; do not select the maximum Sharpe.

analysis_rules.positive_cell: Sharpe > 0, expectancy/trade > 0, valid implementation checks, and profit factor > 1 or undefined because no losing trade exists; trade count is reported separately and does not redefine the observed performance sign
analysis_rules.contiguity: orthogonal four-neighbor adjacency in grid-index space
analysis_rules.local_neighborhood: Chebyshev distance <= 1 in grid-index space, focal cell included
analysis_rules.robust_plateau_cell: positive cell with at least 4 valid neighbors, positive stability score, at least two thirds positive neighbors, and minimum neighbor trade count >= 30
analysis_rules.robust_plateau: at least 2 orthogonally adjacent robust plateau cells
analysis_rules.edge_boundary: orthogonally adjacent positive and non-positive cells; exterior grid limits are reported separately and are not treated as observed edge disappearance
analysis_rules.sensitivity: median Sharpe and median expectancy by each parameter value, plus range of the conditional median Sharpe
analysis_rules.boundary_optimum: highest-Sharpe observed cell has at least one parameter at the minimum or maximum tested value
analysis_rules.plateau_medoid: robust cell minimizing summed Manhattan grid distance to all robust cells in the largest robust component; ties use stability score, then combination id
